correctness.rationale: For all real t>-1, the beta-moment kernel gives exact first two normalized Taylor ratios; the radial ∂∂bar formula yields H_t(0), and differentiation yields strict parameter monotonicity. The binomial closed form supplies a differentiated asymptotic limit -2/(t+2) with a controlled lower-order term. For t=4 the exact rational metric and H=P/(6R^3) were symbolically checked, R is positive, P(0)>0>P(1), and P′<0 follows coefficient dominance on (0,1), proving one sign-changing circle. Rational substitutions isolate its radius. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a motivated geometric phase classification of a natural Kähler invariant for the recently studied Euclidean-distance weighted disk spaces: the positive-center curvature transition differs sharply from the established kernel zero phase, the boundary sign stays negative for all t, and the first integer positive-center example has exactly one sign-change circle with a reproducible algebraic certificate. Neither arbitrary parameter slicing nor a known-table recomputation is used; the integer t=4 is forced by the all-real sharp threshold.
